headers.//: Font filenames are stable and their bytes never change under the same name, so they are safe to freeze. Previously only /assets was immutable, leaving fonts on max-age=0 and revalidating on every repeat visit.

theme-init.js is a SYNC script in <head>, so a revalidation blocks the parser before first paint. It is deliberately NOT immutable: the filename carries no content hash, so a year-long freeze would strand any future fix on returning devices. An hour removes the blocking round trip for a session without that risk.
